name: I-Y-T Raise
instructions: Hinge forward about 45 degrees holding very light dumbbells, arms hanging.
I: raise both arms straight overhead in line with your body, thumbs up.
Y: lower, then raise the arms in a Y shape. T: lower, then raise arms straight out to the sides.
Keep every rep slow and controlled — this is prehab, not a max lift.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the rear delts and middle delts. I-Y-T Raise strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
